iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布推出全新 AI 版 Siri，稱為 **Siri AI**，將於今年稍後以 beta 形式在美國先行上線，並具備跨應用程式的上下文理解與即時資訊呈現功能【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- Apple 在 WWDC 的發表會上正式揭曉 Siri AI，並說明它將在今年秋季以 beta 方式推出，首波僅支援美國英語使用者【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Siri AI 能夠從使用者的 App 中抽取上下文，例如直接回應「我妹妹推薦的播客是什麼」並直接顯示結果，而不必開啟其他應用程式或服務【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 為了讓 Siri AI 具備足夠的智慧，Apple 與 Google 簽署協議，使用 Google Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 以及 Gemini Image）作為底層技術，然而 Apple 強調不使用 Google Search 作為知識庫，也不採用 Google 向客戶部署的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Apple 亦同時開發自家的「Apple Frontier Models」(AFM)，這些模型以自有資料訓練，並透過 Google Gemini Frontier 模型的輸出進行強化學習與微調【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 為了支援高效能運算，Apple 把 Private Cloud Compute 基礎設施擴展至 Nvidia 晶片，並在 Google Cloud 上部署，確保只有 Apple 簽署的軟體能與伺服器通訊，以維持資料隱私與安全【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 除了 Siri AI，Apple 亦宣布其 AI 平台 Apple Intelligence 將在 Safari、密碼與訊息等應用程式中發揮作用，並強調語音輸入與隱私保護的提升【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 影片評論指出，Siri 的升級更著重於實際功能而非炫技，雖然仍處於 beta 階段，但已展現出相當的潛力【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,

. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age

Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

records.query: NVIDIA 最近跟 IREN 之間有什麼合作的新聞？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽下了多項大型合作，包括價值 **34 億美元（$3.4 billion）** 的五年 AI Cloud 合約、最高 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 的投資權利，並將共同部署約 **600,000 GPU** 以及 **5 GW** 的算力容量【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

records.query: 最近有哪些關於 Meta 的利多分析與 AI 投資消息？

**利多分析要點**  
1. **分析師評等**：Morgan Stanley 的 Brian Nowak 於 2026 年 6 月 6 日重申 Meta 被低估，因 AI 投資與競爭壁壘擴大，列為「最佳永續股票」之一，並給予 **$775** 的目標價。[META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]

3. **搜尋業務機會**：若 Meta 搜尋工具保有 10 億使用者，且僅 10% 的每日查詢被貨幣化，預計可產生 **超過 100 億美元（$10 billion）** 的年度營收。[META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]  
4. **高利潤訂閱**：Meta 已開始推出分層訂閱方案，以追求更高毛利的收入來源。[META_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]

**AI 投資與相關布局**  
1. **AI 技術應用**：Meta 在「Family of Apps」中利用 AI 進行內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及提升產品開發效率，並持續投資開發新一代 AI 模型，目標是打造「個人超智慧」[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。  
2. **Meta AI 助理**：Meta AI 已作為跨 App、獨立應用、AI 眼鏡與網頁的助理，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容與連結互動[ META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
3. **合作夥伴**：Meta 與 Microsoft、NVIDIA、AMD、Broadcom 以及 OpenAI 等公司合作，共同推動 AI 硬體與軟體研發[ META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。  
4. **Reality Labs 投資影響**：2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資使整體營運利潤減少約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預計 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，顯示公司仍在長期投入 VR/AR 與 AI 相關硬體，短期內會抑制獲利[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]。  
5. **未來支出分配**：2026 年 Meta 計畫將 Reality Labs 營運費用的 **70%** 用於可穿戴裝置，**30%** 用於 VR 與 Horizon 項目，持續支撐 AI 與沉浸式體驗的研發[ META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

綜合上述，近期的分析與公司文件顯示，Meta 正在透過巨額資本支出與多元 AI 合作，擴大其 AI 能力與高利潤訂閱服務，同時即使 Reality Labs 的投資短期內拖累營運利潤，仍被視為長期成長的關鍵驅動力。

records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的股票，因為它擁有極高的現金產生能力與自由現金流、持續提升的高毛利率與營運利潤、服務與 AI 佈局帶來的高成長與定價能力、穩固的生態系統與 iPhone 銷售動能，以及財務安全的資產負債表，同時受到多位投資大師與分析師的正面評價【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。

**現金與自由現金流**  
- TTM 自由現金流達 **1,292 億美元（$129.2 billion）**，足以覆蓋 **77 億美元（$7.7 billion）** 的股息與 **370 億美元（$37.0 billion）** 的回購，顯示公司現金產生能力遠超資本回報需求【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 同時，Apple 在 TTM 產生 **1,402 億美元（$140.2 billion）** 的營運現金，遠領第二名 Dell 的 **112 億美元（$11.2 billion）**【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

**高毛利與營運利潤**  
- TTM 毛利率 **47.9%**（較 FY2024 的 46.2% 與 FY2019 的 38.2% 上升），營運利潤率 **32.6%**，EBITDA 利潤率 **35.4%**，均領先大多數同業【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 以 LTM 計算，營運現金流利潤率 **31.1%**、營運利潤率 **32.6%**，均遠高於 S&P 中位數的 18.4% 與 18.3%【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  

**服務與 AI 成長動能**  
- 服務部門營收呈雙位數成長，且 Apple 正在提升服務價格，顯示其在生態系統內具備定價權【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- Apple Intelligence、Siri AI 以及在 Safari、Password、Messages 中的 AI 功能，預期將帶來多年度升級與持續的經常性收入【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- AI 整合被視為提升 iPhone 競爭力的關鍵，過去四季 iPhone 成長率已達 **16%**，顯示客戶忠誠度與產品升級效應【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  

**生態系統與產品韌性**  
- Apple 具備「龐大安裝基礎」與「生態系統鎖定」的優勢，服務與硬體的高利潤結構使其在宏觀經濟疲弱（如中國市場）下仍能保持韌性【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  
- Wearables 重新回到成長軌道，受益於健康功能與電池壽命提升，進一步多元化收入來源【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  

**財務安全與資本配置**  
- 現金與有價證券合計 **1,466 億美元（$146.6 billion）**，遠高於 **827 億美元（$82.7 billion）** 的長期負債，淨現金位置正向且持續成長【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- 公司持續執行股息提升與 **1,000 億美元（$100 billion）** 的新回購計畫，為投資人提供具體的回報底線【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

**分析師與投資大師的正面評價**  
- Deep Asset Management 的 Gene Munster 認為 Apple 在 WWDC 後將受益於 AI 及 Siri 重大升級，預期股價上揚【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Ken Griffin 將 Apple 列入其最佳持股名單，Evercore ISI 把目標價提升至 **$365** 並維持「Outperform」評等，稱讚 iPhone 高溢價與即將推出的可折疊機型【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- RiverPark Large Growth Fund 在 2025 Q4 投資者信函中指出，iPhone 17 的銷售超出預期、服務動能強勁，且 AI 功能的早期採用超過內部預期【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  

綜合以上因素——強大的現金流與自由現金流、高毛利與營運利潤、持續成長的服務與 AI 事業、穩固的資產負債表、以及受到多位資深投資人與分析師的肯定——Apple 被視為具備長期投資價值的「永恆」股票。

records.query: NVIDIA 最新財報顯示的營收成長速度如何？加上新聞中它與 IREN 最新的 AI 雲端合作案，這反映出公司在資料中心布局上的哪些具體進展？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在最新財報中顯示，2026 年第一季總營收為 **816 億美元（$81.6 billion）**，較去年同期 **成長 85%**，而資料中心營收則為 **752 億美元（$75.2 billion）**，較去年同期 **成長 92%**（[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]）。  

結合與 IREN 的最新 AI 雲端合作案，這些數據反映出 NVIDIA 正在資料中心布局上取得以下具體進展：

1. **大型 AI 雲端合約**：NVIDIA 與 IREN 簽訂了 **五年期 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） AI Cloud 合約**，用於部署 Air‑cooled Blackwell GPU，並以 60 MW 的容量作為首批部署規模（[NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1]、[NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]、[NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]）。  
2. **投資承諾**：NVIDIA 同時提供 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 投資權利**，該投資金額會隨著 GPU 基礎設施的部署而逐步解鎖，最終在部署 **600,000 台 GPU** 後全部生效（[NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]、[NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0]）。  
3. **AI 基礎設施擴張**：IREN 計畫在 2026 年完成 **480 MW** AI Cloud 容量、約 **150,000 台 GPU**，並於 2027 年擴增至 **1,210 MW**，其中部分容量將由 NVIDIA 的 Blackwell GPU 支持，顯示 NVIDIA 的新一代 GPU 正在成為 IREN AI 資料中心的核心硬體（[NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2]）。  
4. **營收驅動因素**：財報指出，Data Center 營收的高速成長主要受 **Blackwell 300 產品** 以及對 InfiniBand、Spectrum‑X Ethernet、NVLink 等解決方案的需求推動，這與與 IREN 合作部署 Blackwell GPU 的策略相呼應（[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47]）。  

綜合來看，NVIDIA 的營收高速成長與其在 AI 雲端與資料中心領域的佈局同步升溫，透過與 IREN 的大額合約與投資安排，實質加速了 Blackwell GPU 在全球 AI 基礎設施中的部署，進一步鞏固其在資料中心市場的領先地位。

The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

NVIDIA 目前的毛利率為 **74.144995%（TTM 截至 2026‑06‑12）**，顯示公司在 AI 晶片高毛利的商業模式仍然非常強勁【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。

- Jensen Huang 在 2026‑05‑19 的訪談中指出，儘管 H200 晶片目前仍未在中國大規模銷售，但「隨著時間推移」中國市場將會逐步開放，且 H200 已取得「授權可銷往中國」的許可【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。

- 另一方面，新聞亦提到中國最高領導人習近平表示「將更廣泛開放」給外國企業，暗示未來對美國 AI 晶片的政策可能放寬【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #2】。  

**潛在營收影響**  
1. **市場開放的正面預期**：若中國最終允許高階 AI 晶片（如 H200）銷售，NVIDIA 可直接切入全球最大且增長最快的 AI 計算需求市場，預期將為未來營收帶來顯著增長。

綜合而言，NVIDIA 目前維持高達 74.14% 的毛利率，顯示其 AI 晶片具備極佳的利潤結構；若中國市場如 Huang 所言「逐步開放」，未來營收有望受益，但仍需觀察中國本土晶片的競爭動向與政策實際落實情況。

**WWDC 發表的 Siri AI 對未來成長動能的意義**：

1. **AI 功能提升使用者黏著度**  
   - Apple 在 WWDC 正式推出以 Google Gemini 模型為基礎的 **Siri AI**，可從使用者的 App 與訊息中抓取上下文，提供更即時、個人化的回應【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。此功能被視為「將 Siri 從計時器升級為 AI 時代的數位助理」的關鍵一步【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

   - Siri AI 採用 Google 的 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 及 Image 模型，同時結合 Apple 自研的 Apple Frontier Models（AFM），並透過 Nvidia 晶片在 Google Cloud 上的 Private Cloud Compute 執行，確保高效能與隱私保護【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #1】。此多方合作顯示 Apple 在 AI 基礎設施上具備足夠算力，能與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭對手抗衡【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. records.answer:
Alphabet 在 FY2025 相較於 FY2024 的營收成長率約為 15.1%【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #151】。  

- 2024 年度營收為 3,500.18 億美元（$350,018 百萬），2025 年度營收提升至 4,028.36 億美元（$402,836 百萬），兩年之間的增幅為 528.18 億美元（$52,818 百萬），計算得出 (402,836‑350,018) ÷ 350,018 ≈ 15.1% 的成長率【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #151】。  

- Navan 在 2026 年的新聞訪談中指出，透過與 Google Gemini 的合作，Navan 正從「慢速的傳統平台」奪取市場份額，並開拓未曾管理過的旅遊市場，顯示 Google 正以 AI 代理人與 Gemini Enterprise 為核心，將 AI 能力嵌入合作夥伴的產品與服務，讓使用者可直接在 Gemini 平台上完成完整的行程預訂【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

- 這些對話同時說明 Google 的 AI 生態系布局正向兩大方向發展：一是透過 Gemini 讓企業客戶與第三方平台（如 Navan）整合 AI 功能，提升使用者體驗並擴大 AI 服務的觸及範圍；二是以「產品即服務」(PLG) 動作快速擴張，用 AI 代理人提供跨情境的即時服務，從而在傳統旅遊平台之外創造新需求【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #1】【GOOGL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

綜合上述，Alphabet 的營收持續以兩位數成長，同時透過與 Navan 的 Gemini 合作，展現 Google 在 AI 生態系統中從傳統平台奪取市場、擴展 AI 服務應用與加速平台化佈局的明顯進展。

records.query: Tesla 汽車業務的毛利率近期有什麼變化趨勢？加上新聞中 Magnificent Seven 科技股近期全數下跌的報導，這對 Tesla 的股價表現透露什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 汽車業務的毛利率在最新的三個月內出現下滑（從 17.2% 降至 16.9%），但在過去六個月則顯著回升（從 16.8% 提升至 18.7%），顯示短期壓力與中期改善並存【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。

- **三個月比較**：2026 年 6 月底的三個月，總汽車毛利率下降至 16.9%，較 2025 年同季的 17.2% 下降 0.3 個百分點【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- **六個月比較**：2026 年上半年的六個月，總汽車毛利率上升至 18.7%，較 2025 年上半年的 16.8% 提高 1.9 個百分點【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- **表格數據**：同樣的變化在成本與毛利表格中得到印證，三個月毛利率 16.9%（2026）對 17.2%（2025），六個月毛利率 18.7%（2026）對 16.8%（2025）【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #78】。

**對股價的訊號**  
同時，根據路透社報導，對於即將上市的 SpaceX，對沖基金拋售了包括 Tesla 在內的「Magnificent Seven」科技股，導致這七大股票自 6 月 5 日以來全部下跌，相關 ETF 也下跌超過 2.4%【NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0】。此情況顯示市場情緒偏向賣出，Tesla 股價在短期內受到整體科技股拋售的拖累，可能呈現下跌或震盪走勢。

**綜合解讀**  
- 短期內，汽車毛利率的微幅下降與整體科技股拋售同步，暗示投資者對 Tesla 短期獲利與市場情緒持保守態度。  
- 中期而言，六個月毛利率的顯著提升顯示公司在成本控制或產品組合上已有改善，為未來股價提供支撐基礎。  

因此，近期 Tesla 股價的表現更可能受到大盤科技股拋售的負面衝擊，而非僅僅由其汽車毛利率的季節性波動所決定。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 以 AI 功能嵌入 Microsoft 365 產品組合，將其列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 服務的一部份，並透過提升每位使用者收入與座位數來推動雲端營收成長。  

- Microsoft 365 Commercial 包含 Microsoft 365 Copilot，屬於 AI‑powered 商務與生產力平台，與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務共同提供 AI 工具與代理情境（agentic scenarios）【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 微軟明確指出，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的成長依賴於「加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與代理情境」來擴充核心產品與服務，Copilot 即是此類 AI 功能之一【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 在財務指標上，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收的增長度量已將 Copilot 納入計算，屬於「Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue」的組成項目【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #142】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）成本增加 6.8 億美元（$680 million）（+12%），主要因「投資 AI 基礎設施以支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 座位與使用量成長」【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】；同樣的說明亦見於九個月報告（截至 2026‑03‑31）中，成本因「投資 AI 基礎設施以支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 座位與使用量成長」上升 16 億美元（$1.6 billion）（+10%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 毛利總額因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收的擴張而增加 44 億美元（$4.4 billion）（+18%），毛利率亦因「Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的效率提升」而略有上升，儘管同時持續投入 AI 基礎設施與 AI 產品使用量【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #105】；九個月報告同樣指出毛利因「Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的成長」提升 128 億美元（$12.8 billion）（+18%），毛利率因雲端效率提升而上升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109】。  
- 這些資料顯示，Copilot 的整合策略包括：將 Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 產品套件的 AI 核心功能、以座位與每位使用者收入的提升作為成長指標、並投入 AI 基礎設施以支撐 Copilot 的使用量，同時透過雲端服務的規模效應提升毛利率。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 的龐大 PC 市場佔有率與 OEM 授權，將其作為推動 Azure 雲端服務與 Copilot AI 功能使用率的關鍵平台【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

- Windows 屬於 Microsoft 個人電腦（Personal Computing）事業部，提供 Windows OEM 授權、裝置與 Surface 等硬體，形成「Windows + 裝置」的基礎生態系統【MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 微軟明確指出，藉由「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business」以及「grow our share of the PC market」，可提升客戶對 Azure 雲端服務的採用，同時促進與 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer、Xbox Game Pass 等服務的互動與使用率【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- 在策略層面，微軟將 Windows 作為連結本地端與雲端的橋樑，讓企業與個人使用者在 Windows 環境中直接存取 Azure 及 Copilot 等 AI 驅動功能，從而提升這些服務的參與度與黏著度【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

因此，Windows 不僅是作業系統，更是 Microsoft 促進雲端與 Copilot 服務使用的入口與推動力。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在大幅提升對 AWS 基礎設施與人工智慧（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資，以支援長期成長並提升客戶體驗【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  

- **整體投資方向**：Amazon 持續擴大技術與基礎設施支出，涵蓋伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷、租金與公用事業等，以支援 AWS 及其他業務，並預期未來支出將持續上升，特別是為 AI 與機器學習計畫增添基礎設施與人力【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】。2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年上升，主要來自基礎設施支出與折舊攤銷的增加，外匯變動亦使成本上升 3.12 億美元（$312 million）【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】。  

- **AI/ML 與相關新領域**：公司將 AI 與機器學習列為長期增長的關鍵，投資於相關軟硬體開發、衛星寬頻服務與自動駕駛車輛等創新項目，同時透過 AWS 提供廣泛的即時技術服務（包括計算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習）【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  

- **與 Anthropic 的具體投資**：  
  - 2025 年第二季投入 **13 億美元（$1.3 billion）** 於 Anthropic 的可轉換票據，並計畫於 2025 年第四季再投入 **14 億美元（$1.4 billion）**【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37】。  
  - 截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，Anthropic 的非投票優先股帳面價值約為 **148 億美元（$14.8 billion）**【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37】。  
  - 2026 年第一季之後，Amazon 進一步投資 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 成為 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並與其簽訂商業安排，允許在達成特定運算容量里程碑時，透過新發行的可轉換票據或未來的普通股取得資金【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  
  - 同時，Amazon 為 Anthropic 設立最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，於達成里程碑後可供 Anthropic 提取，並保留最高 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 的選擇權以投資於其未來股權融資，該選擇權行使後會減少可用融資額度【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- **與 OpenAI 的投資**：在 2026 年第一季，Amazon 投入 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署承諾書，允許在未來以最高 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的價格購買額外的 Series C 優先股，直至 2028 年底或在特定條件下提前終止【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- **資本支出與成本管理**：Amazon 主要將上述技術與基礎設施成本列為費用，未來在衛星寬頻服務商業化後，部分成本將轉為資本化；同時透過有效的股權激勵與限制性股票單位（RSU）管理股東稀釋，以維持資金彈性並支援長期投資計畫【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 的投資策略是透過持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施、加碼 AI/ML 研發、以及在 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 等前沿 AI 企業中佈局大量股權與融資安排，來鞏固其雲端與人工智慧領域的領先地位，同時以成本費用化與資本化的靈活方式管理財務與股東稀釋風險。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨的主要反壟斷與監管風險如下：

1. **AWS 雲端服務的競爭與消費者保護調查**  
   - 亞馬遜正受到多項開放式調查，指稱其 AWS 雲端服務可能違反競爭或消費者保護相關規定，這些調查屬於政府與監管機構對其雲端業務的審查之一【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。  
   - 同樣的調查內容亦在 2025 年的 10‑K 報告中重申，說明 AWS 仍在接受相關競爭與消費者保護法規的審查【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  

2. **Prime 服務與履約網路的反壟斷風險**  
   - 亞馬遜的 Prime 服務與其履約中心（包括倉儲與配送網路）被指可能侵犯競爭或消費者保護規則，相關調查聚焦於其在平台上可能的優勢濫用與市場支配行為【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】。  
   - 2025 年的 10‑K 亦指出，亞馬遜面臨的調查包括對 Prime 及其店舖運營（含履約網路）的競爭相關指控，這些指控可能涉及濫用支配地位的風險【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  

3. **電商平台（Marketplace）相關的反壟斷與消費者保護訴訟**  
   - 亞馬遜正被多個州檢察長、聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）以及私人原告提起訴訟，指稱其在價格設定、商品展示（Featured Offers）、使用賣家資料、廣告與自有商品推廣等方面從事價格固定、濫用支配地位、壟斷或企圖壟斷等違法行為【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99】。  
   - 這些訴訟要求的賠償包括數十億美元的損害賠償、三倍賠償、懲罰性賠償以及禁令、結構性救濟與民事罰金等，若最終判決不利，將對亞馬遜的財務與營運產生重大衝擊【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99】。  

4. **資料隱私與「門檻者」規範的合規成本**  
   - 亞馬遜同時面臨關於資料收集、使用與披露的法律與規範調查，監管機構正逐步將大型科技公司列為「線上門檻者」並加強相關法規，這將提升合規成本並可能限制其業務運作【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #114】。  

5. **其他監管挑戰**  
   - 在歐洲（如義大利）亦有稅務與其他合規挑戰，屬於監管風險的一環【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。  

綜合以上，AWS 受到競爭與消費者保護調查，Prime 與履約網路則面臨可能的濫用支配地位指控，電商平台則被指控價格固定、壟斷與不公平的市場操作，且資料隱私與「門檻者」規範的持續加碼亦將提升合規成本，所有這些風險皆可能導致巨額罰款、營運限制或必須調整商業慣例。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 把 Gemini AI 深度嵌入搜尋、工作與雲端服務，讓 AI 功能遍佈整個生態系。  

- 在搜尋方面，Alphabet 以 Gemini 3 為核心，將其「最先進的多模態理解」與「增強推理」能力直接嵌入 Google Search，讓使用者在搜尋時即能受惠於 Gemini 的生成式與代理式技術【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。同時，Google 透過「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」等功能，利用 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力，讓使用者可以以自然語言提出更複雜的問題，並即時得到更完整的回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

- 在其他產品與服務中，Alphabet 表示全部 15 個「半億用戶」的產品（包括七個擁有二億用戶的產品）皆已使用 Gemini 模型，顯示 Gemini 已成為公司多元產品的共同 AI 基礎【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- 在工作與協作平台，Google 以「Gemini for Google Workspace」將 Gemini AI 整合至 Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Meet 等雲端辦公工具，協助使用者撰寫、組織、視覺化與加速工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  

- 在雲端與企業服務，Alphabet 透過「Gemini Enterprise」提供企業團隊在安全平台上使用 AI 代理，並在 Google Cloud Platform、Vertex AI 以及各類 AI 基礎設施（包括自家 TPU）中提供 Gemini 系列模型，支援客戶建置、調校與部署自訂 AI 應用【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #71】。  

- 此外，Google One 訂閱服務也讓消費者可存取最先進的 Gemini 模型，將 AI 功能延伸至個人用戶層面【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

- 最後，Alphabet 針對終端使用者推出了專屬的 Gemini App，提供 AI 代理與互動式體驗，進一步擴大 Gemini 在整個產品生態系的觸及範圍【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises. At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development. Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. For our Google Cloud customers, our offerings are helping organizations stay at the forefront of innovation with solutions such as Gemini Enterprise and Gemini for Google Workspace. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過引入大型語言模型，將傳統的十條藍色連結搜尋介面轉變為具備多模態、自然語言互動的 AI 驅動體驗，進而推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 兩項功能，以因應生成式 AI 帶來的搜尋變革【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- **大型語言模型與多模態化**：Google 以大型語言模型（LLM）支援更自然的語句查詢，讓使用者能以更口語化、複雜的問題與搜尋互動，提升回應的品質與深度【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Overviews**：此功能讓使用者只要提出「問 Google 任何事」的指令，即可得到一段綜合性的概述回應，降低需要多次點擊搜尋結果的需求【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **AI Mode**：在搜尋框內啟用 AI Mode 後，使用者可提出更細緻、具多步驟推理的問題，系統會利用 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力提供更具洞見的答案，取代過去可能需要多次搜尋才能得到的資訊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **產品開發與變現策略**：Google 在開發 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 時，首先聚焦於提升使用者體驗，之後才考慮變現方式，這與過去以廣告為主的收入模式形成差異，並可能因 AI 產品的不同毛利結構影響整體營收與毛利趨勢【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  
- **競爭與未來展望**：Google 也指出，隨著其他開發者與 AI 服務供應商的競爭加劇，AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 的成長與營收表現將受到市場競爭的影響，同時這些 AI 產品的使用量提升將推動雲端與企業 AI 解決方案的需求【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #289】。  

總結來說，Google 搜尋藉由大型語言模型與多模態技術，推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，讓使用者能以更自然、深入的方式提問，並在提升使用者體驗的同時，為公司未來的收入結構與競爭布局奠定基礎。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一代計算平台」── 以沉浸式的 AR/VR 體驗與先進的人工智慧結合，最終形成類似「元宇宙」與「個人超智慧」的生態系統【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

- 為了實現這一願景，Meta 正持續擴大 AI 模型的開發與訓練，投入生成式 AI、超智慧（superintelligence）以及開源 Llama 基礎模型等領域，並將 AI 融入內容排序、廣告工具、產品開發與新功能中【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 同時，Reality Labs 成為實體硬體與沉浸式平台的核心投資單位。Meta 計畫在 2026 年將 Reality Labs 營運費用的約 70% 用於可穿戴裝置（如 AI 眼鏡），其餘 30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon 相關項目【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 具體產品方面，Meta 已推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 頭盔、具通透功能的沉浸式體驗、Ray‑Ban Meta 與 Oakley Meta AI 眼鏡，以及 2025 年的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 與 Meta Neural Band，這些皆是結合 AI 助理與新型 AR/VR 硬體的實例【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- 這些大規模的 AI 與 Reality Labs 投資已在短期內對財務產生負面衝擊：2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資減少了約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）的營運利潤，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，顯示公司願意承受長期財務壓力以換取未來平台的突破【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188】。  

總結而言，Meta 正以 AI 研發與 Reality Labs 硬體創新為雙軸，持續投入資源與資本，目標是將社交、內容與商業服務從傳統 2D 螢幕遷移至以 AI 驅動的沉浸式元宇宙平台。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等「Family of Apps」上顯示廣告賺錢，廣告收入來自廣告主依照 **展示次數 (impressions)** 或 **使用者行動 (clicks、其他動作)** 付費，而 Meta AI 則被嵌入這些 App，協助內容排序、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及提升使用者的學習與創作效率【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

**Meta 的廣告獲利模式**  
- **即時認列**：對於以展示次數計價的廣告，Meta 在「廣告展示」的合約期間內認列收入；對於以使用者完成特定行動計價的廣告，則在使用者完成該行動的期間認列收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **平均每則廣告價格**：Meta 以「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放的廣告數量」計算平均每則廣告的價格，這個指標不受廣告主的目標（impression 或 action）影響【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **產品差異化**：不同廣告產品的變現率不同，例如影片與 Reels 的變現率目前低於 Feed 或 Stories，Meta 會依產品與策略調整廣告數量與頻率【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
- **非主要代理**：若廣告收入安排中 Meta 不是主要方，則以淨額方式認列收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  

**Meta AI 在旗下 App 中的角色**  
- **跨平台助理**：Meta AI 以助理形式出現在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp、Threads 等 App，亦提供獨立的應用程式、AI 眼鏡與網頁版，協助使用者「學習、完成任務、創作內容、連結他人」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **內容排序與發現**：AI 模型被用於「內容排序」與「推薦引擎」，提升使用者在各 App 中看到的相關內容，間接增強廣告的投放效果【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **廣告工具支援**：Meta AI 為廣告主提供更精準的目標設定與測量工具，提升廣告需求與平均每則廣告價格【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **生成式 AI 體驗**：AI 研發支援新一代的生成式 AI 功能，讓使用者在 App 內能即時產生文字、影像或影片等內容，擴大使用黏著度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **產品開發效率**：AI 也被用於內部產品開發流程，提升開發與測試的效率，間接加速新功能與新廣告產品的上市速度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過即時認列的展示與行動付費廣告、以平均每則廣告價格衡量變現效率，並藉由 Meta AI 在所有主要 App 中提供內容排序、廣告工具與生成式 AI 體驗，形成廣告收入與技術創新相互支撐的商業模式。

As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把全自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是透過自家 AI 演算法、專屬推論晶片、全車 OTA 軟體更新，以及以此為基礎的 Robotaxi 服務與訂閱模式來實現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。

- **全車設計即具備自動駕駛能力**：Tesla 表示「每一台交付的車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，並持續以 AI 研發提升 FSD（Supervised）功能，讓其在安全與便利性上與傳統駕駛輔助系統形成明顯區隔【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **自研 AI 與硬體**：公司使用「自家設計的推論晶片」來加速神經網路運算，並將這些 AI 產出應用於自動駕駛與機器人（如 Optimus）等多元領域，形成技術壁壘【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **OTA 軟體持續升級**：Tesla 透過「空中軟體更新」不斷改進 FSD 功能與車輛控制軟體，確保新功能能即時布署至所有車主，提升使用者體驗與安全性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **Robotaxi 服務與訂閱模式**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務，以 Model Y 為首的自動駕駛車隊搭配 FSD（Supervised）訂閱，旨在打造「以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務驅動商業模式」，此模式在現有的乘車平台中具備獨特的 AI 及軟體優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **品牌與整合優勢**：Tesla 強調其「垂直整合的商業模式」與「全車軟體」的開發能力，使其在自動駕駛領域的規格、功能與使用者體驗上具備競爭優勢，與其他僅提供硬體或單一軟體解決方案的競爭者形成差異【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30】。  
- **與競爭者的差異點**：在 AI 與機器人領域的競爭中，Tesla 以「持續的 FSD（Supervised）與神經網路能力進步」以及「自有的 Supercharger 網路與資訊娛樂系統」作為與傳統叫車服務及其他自動駕駛開發者的核心區隔【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51】。  

綜合上述，Tesla 透過自研 AI、專屬硬體、全車 OTA 更新、以及以 FSD 為核心的 Robotaxi 訂閱服務，形成了與其他電動車與自動駕駛競爭者明顯的差異化優勢。

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「高度且日益加劇」的競爭態勢，主要表現在以下幾個面向：

1. **傳統與新興車廠的全方位競爭**  
   - 多家既有大型汽車製造商以及新進業者已在美國、中國、歐洲等主要市場推出或計畫推出內燃機、混合動力、插電式混合動力以及全電動車型，直接與 Tesla 的 Cybertruck、Model S、Model X、Model 3、Model Y 等車系爭奪相同細分市場【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50】。  
   - 這些競爭者往往擁有「更充足或更成熟的資源」來投入設計、開發、製造、分銷、行銷與售後服務，且因生產基地或經濟環境的優勢可取得成本效益【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

2. **自動駕駛與車載軟體平台的競爭**  
   - 除了車輛本身，Tesla 亦面臨來自其他公司在自動駕駛技術與相關服務領域的激烈競爭，這些公司同樣在電動與替代燃料車輛以及自駕技術上投入資源【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  
   - 若自動駕駛解決方案的採用率未達預期，將可能削弱 Tesla 的營運表現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

3. **政府與經濟激勵的差異化影響**  
   - 某些政府提供的本土組裝或本地供應鏈激勵可能更有利於競爭對手，進一步削弱 Tesla 的獲利空間【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

4. **能源產生與儲存業務的競爭**  
   - 在能源發電與儲能領域，Tesla 亦須與其他製造商、開發商、安裝服務商以及大型公用事業公司競爭，且電價下降或其他可再生能源成本降低亦可能使 Tesla 產品的吸引力下降【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

5. **機器人（Bots）與機械人技術的競爭**  
   - Tesla 正在開發包括 Optimus 在內的機器人產品，該市場仍屬新興且競爭激烈，其他公司亦在設計、開發與製造機械人應用，若 Tesla 的 Bots 計畫未如預期發展，將對其整體業務構成風險【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。

綜合上述，Tesla 必須同時應對傳統汽車大廠與新興電動車廠商在車型、技術、成本與政策激勵方面的多層次競爭，且其在能源與機器人領域的擴張亦面臨相當的外部挑戰。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？

能源生成與儲能業務是特斯拉產品組合中的一個獨立事業部，提供太陽能板、Powerwall、Megapack 等發電與儲能解決方案，並透過設計、製造、安裝、銷售、租賃及相關服務來服務住宅、商業、工業與公用事業客戶【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，它在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦與平板電腦市場僅佔「少數」市場份額，且必須面對高度激烈且持續變化的競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

- **市場佔有率**：Apple 明確說明自己在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置市場皆只有「少數」的市佔（minority market share）【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **競爭環境**：公司描述這些市場「高度競爭」，特徵包括：  
  - 競爭者以激進的價格策略與低成本結構爭奪市場，導致價格競爭激烈、毛利率承受下行壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】；  
  - 產品生命週期短、技術快速演進與新產品頻繁推出，使得 Apple 必須持續創新以維持競爭力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】；  
  - 競爭者常模仿 Apple 的產品功能與設計，甚至試圖侵害其智慧財產權，進一步加劇競爭【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **競爭風險**：10‑K 亦指出，若 Apple 無法持續推出具吸引力且高毛利的創新產品，或是競爭者以極低甚至虧損的價格提供相似解決方案，Apple 的競爭優勢與股價可能受到「實質性不利」影響【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #103】。  

總結來說，Apple 自己在 10‑K 中承認在智慧型手機、PC 與平板市場僅佔少數市場份額，並強調這些市場的激烈價格競爭、快速技術變化與競爭者的模仿行為構成主要的競爭壓力。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過 **App Store 作為主要的第三方應用程式分發渠道**，以及 **開發者對於相較於 Android、Windows 等競爭平台的感知利益（包括市場規模、預期收入、未來成長與開發成本）**，來提升其生態系的黏著度【AAPL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #3】、【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

- **App Store 分發機制**：Apple 只透過 App Store 向消費者提供第三方應用程式，這成為開發者接觸 iPhone、iPad、Mac 等裝置使用者的唯一官方管道【AAPL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #3】。  
- **感知利益驅動**：開發者在決定是否投入資源於 Apple 平台時，會比較 Android（Android）與 Windows（Windows）等競爭平台的 **市場地位、可預期的營收、未來成長潛力以及開發成本**，若 Apple 在這些面向被視為具吸引力，則開發者的黏著度會提升【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **市場佔有率的影響**：文件指出 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的 **市場佔有率較低**，這可能使開發者較不願意將資源投入 Apple 平台，進而影響黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。因此，Apple 必須透過提升 App Store 的收益分潤、提供獨特的硬體與服務整合（如 Apple Silicon、Apple One）以及持續擴大其裝置生態，來增強開發者的感知利益，進而鞏固黏著度。  

總結來說，Apple 依賴 **App Store 的唯一分發渠道**，並透過 **提升開發者在收入、成長與成本上的相對優勢**，來建立相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的開發者黏著度，同時必須克服因市場佔有率較低而帶來的挑戰。

The Company’s future performance depends in part on support from third-party software developers. The Company believes decisions by customers to purchase its hardware products depend in part on the availability of third-party software applications and services. Third-party developers may discontinue the development and maintenance of software applications and services for the Company’s products. If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products, adversely impacting the Company’s business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company believes that third-party developer support depends on the perceived benefits of creating software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. Failure to obtain or create digital content that appeals to the Company’s customers, or to make such content available on commercially reasonable terms, could have a material adverse impact on the Company’s business, results of operations and financial condition. The Company contracts with numerous third parties to offer their digital content to customers. This includes the right to sell, or offer subscriptions to, third-party content, as well as the right to incorporate specific content into the Company’s own services. The licensing or other distribution arrangements for this content can be for relatively short time periods and do not guarantee the continuation or renewal of these arrangements on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Some third-party content providers and distributors currently or in the future may offer competing products and services, and can take actions to make it difficult or impossible for the Company to license or otherwise distribute their content. Other content owners, providers or distributors may seek to limit the Company’s access to, or increase the cost of, such content. The Company may be unable to continue to offer a wide variety of content at commercially reasonable prices with acceptable usage rules. The Company also produces its own digital content, which can be costly to produce due to intense and increasing competition for talent, content and subscribers, and may fail to appeal to the Company’s customers. The Company’s success depends largely on the talents and efforts of its team members, the continued service and availability of highly skilled employees, including key personnel, and the Company’s ability to nurture its distinctive and inclusive culture. Much of the Company’s future success depends on the talents and efforts of its team members and the continued availability and service of key personnel, including its Chief Executive Officer, executive team and other highly skilled employees. Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.

We have a network of field sales representatives and field support personnel that solicit orders from distributors and resellers and provide product training and sales support. Our Dynamics business solutions are also licensed to enterprises through a global network of channel partners providing vertical solutions and specialized services. OEMs 

We distribute our products and services through OEMs that pre-install our software on new devices and servers they sell. The largest component of the OEM business is the Windows operating system pre-installed on devices. OEMs also sell devices pre-installed with other Microsoft products and services, including applications such as Office and the capability to subscribe to Microsoft 365 Consumer. There are two broad categories of OEMs. The largest category of OEMs are direct OEMs as our relationship with them is managed through a direct agreement between Microsoft and the OEM. We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo, and with many regional and local OEMs. The second broad category of OEMs are system builders consisting of lower-volume PC manufacturers, which source Microsoft software for pre-installation and local redistribution primarily through the Microsoft distributor channel rather than through a direct agreement or relationship with Microsoft. LICENSING OPTIONS 

We offer options for organizations of varying sizes that want to purchase our cloud services and on-premises software. We license these organizations under volume licensing agreements to allow the customer to acquire multiple licenses of products and services instead of having to acquire separate licenses through retail channels. These volume licensing programs have varying programmatic requirements and benefits to best meet the needs of our customers. Software Assurance (“SA”) conveys rights to new software and upgrades for perpetual licenses released over the contract period. It also provides support, tools, training, and other licensing benefits to help customers deploy and use software efficiently. SA is required to be purchased with certain volume licensing agreements and is an optional purchase with others. Volume Licensing Programs

Enterprise Agreement 

Enterprise Agreements offer large organizations a manageable volume licensing program that gives them the flexibility to buy cloud services and software licenses under one agreement. Enterprise Agreements are designed for medium or large organizations that want to license Microsoft products and services organization-wide over a three-year period. Organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses (covered with SA) and/or subscribe to cloud services. Microsoft Customer Agreement

Microsoft Customer Agreements are simplified purchase agreements presented, accepted, and stored through a digital experience. Microsoft Customer Agreements are non-expiring agreements that are designed to support all customers over time, whether purchasing through a partner or directly from Microsoft. Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement

Microsoft Online Subscription Agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to subscribe to, activate, provision, and maintain cloud services seamlessly and directly via the web. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. GOVERNMENT REGULATION 

We are subject to a wide range of laws, regulations, and legal requirements in the U.S.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Growth depends on our ability to attract new users, understand intent, and match intent with relevant content on advertising offerings. Competition 

Windows faces competition from various software products and from alternative platforms and devices. We believe Windows competes effectively by giving customers choice, value, flexibility, security, an easy-to-use interface, and compatibility with a broad range of hardware and software applications, including those that enable productivity. Devices face competition from various computer, tablet, and hardware manufacturers who offer a unique combination of high-quality industrial design and innovative technologies across various price points. Many of these manufacturers are also current or potential partners and customers, including our Windows OEMs. Xbox and our cloud gaming services face competition from various online gaming ecosystems and game streaming services. We also compete with other providers of entertainment services such as video streaming platforms. Our gaming platform competes with other console platforms. We believe our gaming platform is effectively positioned against, and uniquely differentiated from, competitive products and services based on significant innovation in hardware architecture, user interface, developer tools, online gaming and entertainment services, and continued strong content from our own first-party game franchises as well as other digital content offerings. Our Search and news advertising business competes with search engines, and a wide array of websites, social platforms, and portals that provide content and online offerings to end users. HUMAN CAPITAL RESOURCES

As of June 30, 2025, we employed approximately 228,000 people on a full-time basis, 125,000 in the U.S. and 103,000 internationally. Of the total employees, 89,000 were in operations, including product support and consulting services, datacenter operations, and manufacturing and distribution; 80,000 were in product research and development; 44,000 were in sales and marketing; and 15,000 were in general and administration. Certain employees are subject to collective bargaining agreements.

Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的最新季營收約為 **131.92 億美元（$13,192 百萬）**，較 2025 年同季微幅下降約 **1%**，屬於基本持平的表現【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。

- **Gaming** 版塊收入下降 **11 億美元（$1.1 billion）**，跌幅 **6%**，主要受 Xbox 硬體與內容服務銷售減少影響，對營收形成負向壓力【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- **Search advertising** 收入則增加 **10 億美元（$1.0 billion）**，增幅 **10%**，在一定程度上抵消了 Gaming 的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  

因此，More Personal Computing 的營收雖然整體上看似持平，但實際上是 **Windows/Devices 的小幅增長** 與 **Gaming 的顯著下降** 以及 **Search advertising 的顯著增長** 互相抵銷所致。

records.query: Microsoft 最新一季整體營業利益成長多少？主要由哪些部門帶動？
records.answer:
Microsoft 在最新一季（截至2026年3月31日的三個月）營業利益為 **383.98 億美元（$38,398 百萬）**，較上年同季的 **320 億美元（$32,000 百萬）** 增長 **約20%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

此成長主要來自兩大事業部：

* **Productivity and Business Processes（生產力與商務流程）** 營業利益從 **173.79 億美元（$17,379 百萬）** 提升至 **209.73 億美元（$20,973 百萬）**，增幅 **21%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  
* **Intelligent Cloud（智慧雲端）** 營業利益從 **110.95 億美元（$11,095 百萬）** 提升至 **137.53 億美元（$13,753 百萬）**，增幅 **24%**，且該部門營收亦從 **267.51 億美元（$26,751 百萬）** 增至 **346.81 億美元（$34,681 百萬）**（增長30%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

相較之下，More Personal Computing（個人電腦）部門的營業利益僅小幅上升 4%（35.26 億美元（$3,526 百萬） → 36.72 億美元（$3,672 百萬）），對整體成長貢獻較小【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

因此，Microsoft 本季營業利益的 20% 成長，主要由 Productivity and Business Processes 與 Intelligent Cloud 兩大部門的強勁表現所驅動。

因此，客戶使用量的顯著上升是推動 AWS 營業利益成長的核心動力，而長期合約的價格調整則對此成長形成一定的抑制。

Cost of Sales

Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. The increase in cost of sales in Q1 2026, compared to the comparable prior year period, is primarily due to increased product and shipping costs resulting from increased sales, partially offset by operational efficiencies. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased cost of sales by $1.8 billion for Q1 2026. Shipping costs were $22.5 billion and $25.7 billion in Q1 2025 and Q1 2026. Shipping costs to receive products from our suppliers are included in our inventory and recognized as cost of sales upon sale of products to our customers. We expect our cost of shipping to continue to increase to the extent our customers accept and use our shipping offers at an increasing rate, we use more expensive shipping methods, and we offer additional services. We seek to mitigate costs of shipping over time in part through achieving higher sales volumes, optimizing our fulfillment network, negotiating better terms with our suppliers, and achieving better operating efficiencies. We believe that offering low prices to our customers is fundamental to our future success, and one way we offer lower prices is through shipping offers. Costs to operate our AWS segment are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure” as we leverage a shared infrastructure that supports both our internal technology requirements and external sales to AWS customers. Fulfillment

Fulfillment costs primarily consist of those costs incurred in operating and staffing our North America and International fulfillment centers, physical stores, and customer service centers and payment processing costs. While AWS payment processing and related transaction costs are included in “Fulfillment,” AWS costs are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure.” Fulfillment costs as a percentage of net sales may vary due to several factors, such as payment processing and related transaction costs, our level of productivity and accuracy, changes in volume, size, and weight of units received and fulfilled, the extent to which third-party sellers utilize Fulfillment by Amazon services, timing of fulfillment network and physical store expansion, the extent we utilize fulfillment services provided by third parties, mix of products and services sold, and our ability to affect customer service contacts per unit by implementing improvements in our operations and enhancements to our customer self-service features. Additionally, sales by our sellers have higher payment processing and related transaction costs as a percentage of net sales compared to our retail sales because payment processing costs are based on the gross purchase price of underlying transactions.

[AMZN 10-Q period 202603] In addition, economic conditions and actions by policymaking bodies are contributing to changing interest rates and significant capital market volatility, which, along with any increases in our borrowing levels, could increase our future borrowing costs. Results of Operations

We have organized our operations into three segments: North America, International, and AWS. These segments reflect the way the Company evaluates its business performance and manages its operations. See Item 1 of Part I, “Financial Statements — Note 8 — Segment Information.”

Overview

Macroeconomic factors, including changes in inflation and interest rates, resource and supply volatility, global economic and geopolitical developments, including unpredictable shifts in global tariff and trade policies, and the development and adoption of technologies and services, including artificial intelligence, have direct and indirect impacts on our results of operations that are difficult to predict, isolate, and quantify. These could affect customer demand for our products and services, our ability to forecast growth needs, expenses, and benefits from new technologies. Further, we expect to continue making additional investments in our artificial intelligence initiatives. We expect some or all of these factors to continue to impact our results of operations into Q2 2026. Net Sales

records.query: Google Cloud 部門最新一季的營收成長多少？
records.answer:
Google Cloud 在最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月）營收較去年同季增加了 **111 億美元（$11.1 billion）**【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  

- 2025 年 6 月 30 日止三個月的 Google Cloud 營收為 **136.24 億美元（$13.624 billion）**（以百萬計為 $13,624）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 2026 年 6 月 30 日止三個月的 Google Cloud 營收為 **247.68 億美元（$24.768 billion）**（以百萬計為 $24,768）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 因此，營收增幅為 247.68 億美元（$24.768 billion） − 136.24 億美元（$13.624 billion） = **111.44 億美元（$11.144 billion）**，四捨五入後在文件中表述為 **111 億美元（$11.1 billion）**【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
本季 NVIDIA 在中國的資料中心晶片基本上仍未出貨，僅在有限授權下取得約 6,000 萬美元的 H20 相關營收，與去年同季幾乎零出貨的情形相比，變化不大。  

- 受美國政府於 2022‑2025 年間持續的出口限制與授權要求，NVIDIA 已「實質上被排除在中國資料中心計算市場之外」​[NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #75]，且在 2025 財政年度亦同樣「被排除」​[NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #85]，因此在本季（2025 年 10 月 26 日結束的三個月）與去年同季（2024 年 10 月 27 日結束的三個月）均無正常的資料中心晶片出貨。  

- 2025 年 8 月美國政府開始允許部分 H20 產品向中國客戶出貨，NVIDIA 因此在授權後「產生約 0.6 億美元（$60 百萬）的 H20 營收」​[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #94]。此營收屬於受限且有限的授權範圍，並未改變整體在中國資料中心市場的出貨被阻斷的事實。  

- 由於去年（2024 年 10 月 27 日結束的季度）尚未取得任何此類授權，當時並未有任何來自中國的資料中心晶片營收或出貨，亦未提及任何正向變化​[NVDA_10Q_202510.html, chunk #85]。  

綜合上述，2025 財政年度第三季 NVIDIA 在中國的資料中心晶片仍基本無出貨，僅有少量 H20 產品帶來約 6,000 萬美元的有限營收，與去年同季的零出貨狀況相比，變化幅度極小。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家在做 AI 幾乎都依賴 NVIDIA，是因為它提供了從硬體到軟體完整的加速運算平台，且在效能、成本與生態系上具備領先優勢。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]  

1. **全堆疊平台與硬體領先**：NVIDIA 同時提供 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU，並將晶片、互連、系統與軟體全部共同設計，形成資料中心規模的 AI 基礎建設，讓訓練與推論都能在同一平台上高效執行。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]、[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。  

2. **軟體生態與開發者基礎**：公司擁有 CUDA 開發平台、數百個領域專屬的函式庫、SDK、API，以及 NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整軟體套件，為企業提供端到端的 AI 應用開發與部署環境。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]、[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。全球已有超過 **0.075 億（7.5 百萬）** 開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具，形成龐大且持續擴張的生態系統，提升平台的價值與吸引力。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。  

3. **效能與成本優勢**：2024 年推出的 Blackwell Ultra 平台（於 FY2026 正式上線並擴展）在 agentic、推理與實體 AI 工作負載上提供顯著的 token 吞吐量提升，且每個 token 的成本較前代 Hopper 大幅下降，讓 AI 模型的運算成本更具競爭力。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。此外，2026 年公布的 Rubin 平台預計在 FY2027 開始量產，宣稱相較於 Blackwell 可達 **10 倍** 的成本降低，進一步強化 NVIDIA 在成本效益上的領先地位。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25]。  

4. **產業合作與應用範圍**：NVIDIA 與主要伺服器製造商、雲端服務供應商（CSP）以及各行各業的 OEM、ODM、系統整合商深度合作，將其平台廣泛佈署於醫療、金融、製造、零售、汽車等多個數十億美元的終端市場，形成跨產業的需求網絡。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]、[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25]。  

5. **研發投入與技術領先**：自成立以來，NVIDIA 已投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 用於研發，持續推出 GPU、Tensor Core、AI 專屬指令集與新架構（如 Blackwell），確保其技術始終走在 AI 計算的最前端。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。  

綜合以上硬體、軟體、生態系、效能成本與產業合作的全方位優勢，使得 AI 開發者與企業在選擇加速運算平台時，幾乎必須依賴 NVIDIA 的技術，其他競爭者難以在短時間內複製這樣的完整價值鏈。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365 產品中加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，將生成式 AI 與 OpenAI 的大型語言模型整合到雲端服務，進而在 Office 相關的生產力工具中提供 AI 功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。

- **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 被描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」 ，它結合了 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務，讓 AI 能在 Microsoft 365 商業與消費者版中使用【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 微軟與 **OpenAI** 的長期策略夥伴關係使微軟持有 OpenAI 的知識產權（包括模型與基礎設施），並將這些模型整合至 Azure 及 Azure OpenAI 服務，提供給自家產品使用【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #139】。  
- 公司亦指出「我們正在將 AI 建入許多產品與服務」 ，這表示 AI 功能已被嵌入到包括 Microsoft 365、Power BI、Teams 等在內的多項生產力服務中【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #98】。  

因此，微軟的做法是利用 Microsoft 365 Copilot 作為 AI 功能的入口，並透過與 OpenAI 的合作把大型語言模型部署在 Azure 上，讓這些 AI 能力在 Office 相關的雲端服務與生產力應用中即時提供支援。

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Our Future Opportunity

We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas. We continue to develop complete, intelligent solutions for our customers that empower people to be productive and collaborate, while safeguarding businesses and simplifying IT management. Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth. We are investing significant resources in:

•Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another. •Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals. •Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. •Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways. •Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming. •Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more. •Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms. Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions. Commitment to Sustainability

Microsoft is committed to sustainability and our approach to addressing climate change starts with the sustainability of our own business. In 2020, we announced goals to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030. Since announcing these goals, we have made meaningful progress while having seen major changes in both the technology sector and in our understanding of what it will take to meet our goals.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Our products and services may contain defects in design, manufacture, or operation that make them insecure or ineffective for their intended purposes. For example, customers control our products and services, including our AI products, within their environments, and may deploy them in high-risk scenarios or utilize them inappropriately. Our products may also collect large amounts of data in manners which may not satisfy customers or regulatory requirements. Our customers also operate complex systems with third-party hardware and software from multiple vendors whose products or personnel may take or fail to take actions which impact the reliability or security of our products and services. If our products and services do not work as intended, are utilized in methods not intended, violate the law, or harm individuals or businesses, we may be subject to legal claims or enforcement actions. These risks, if realized, may increase our costs, damage our reputation, or adversely affect our results of operations. Issues in the development, deployment, and use of AI may result in reputational or competitive harm or liability. We are building AI into many of our offerings, including our productivity services, and we are also making AI available for our customers to use in solutions that they build. This AI may be developed by Microsoft or others, including our strategic partner, OpenAI. We expect these elements of our business to grow.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Each industry shift is an opportunity to conceive new products, new technologies, or new ideas that can further transform the industry and our business. At Microsoft, we push the boundaries of what is possible through a broad range of research and development activities that seek to identify and address the changing demands of customers and users, industry trends, and competitive forces. Microsoft and OpenAI maintain a long-term strategic partnership originally established in 2019. Microsoft is a major investor in OpenAI, and the companies have reciprocal revenue-sharing arrangements. We hold rights to OpenAI’s intellectual property, including models and infrastructure, for integration into our products. The OpenAI API is exclusive to Azure, runs on Azure, and is available through the Azure OpenAI Service. We also have a right of first refusal on OpenAI's new capacity needs. Economic Conditions, Challenges, and Risks

The markets for software, devices, and cloud-based services are dynamic and highly competitive. Our competitors are developing new software and devices, while also deploying competing cloud-based services for consumers and businesses. The devices and form factors customers prefer evolve rapidly, influencing how users access services in the cloud and, in some cases, the user’s choice of which suite of cloud-based services to use. Aggregate demand for our software, services, and devices is also correlated to global macroeconomic and geopolitical factors, which remain dynamic. We must continue to evolve and adapt over an extended time in pace with this changing environment. The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins. We continue to identify and evaluate opportunities to expand our datacenter locations and increase our server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services. Our datacenters depend on the availability of permitted and buildable land, predictable energy, networking supplies, and servers, including graphics processing units (“GPUs”) and other components. Our devices are primarily manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers.

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜在 2026 年第一季大幅投入 AI，先後向兩家領先的生成式 AI 企業投入數十億美元的股權與資金。  

- 亞馬遜於 2026 Q1 投資 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署承諾書，未來可再購買 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的同類股份【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】；同時，亞馬遜與 OpenAI 簽訂了商業合作協議，主要提供 AWS 雲端服務與 AWS 晶片，讓 OpenAI 模型可在 AWS 上使用【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #41】。  

- 針對 Anthropic，亞馬遜在同一季 **投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 的非投票優先股，並設立最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，供 Anthropic 在達成算力交付里程碑後提取，提取方式為新發可轉換債或未來上市後的普通股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- 這些投資與合作在 2026 Q1 產生的現金支出（扣除取得的現金）為 **154 億美元（$15.4 billion）**，亞馬遜表示將以手頭現金資金完成相關投資【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

因此，亞馬遜近期的 AI 砸錢行動包括：向 OpenAI 投入 150 億美元（$15 billion）並承諾額外 350 億美元（$35 billion）、與 OpenAI 簽署 AWS 雲端與晶片服務合作、向 Anthropic 投入 50 億美元（$5 billion）並提供最高 200 億美元（$20 billion）的融資設施，總現金支出約 154 億美元（$15.4 billion）。

records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，朝打造以沉浸式 AR/VR 為核心的「下一代計算平台」發展，短期聚焦可穿戴裝置，長期布局元宇宙與個人超智慧【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **產品方向**：Meta 的 Reality Labs 目前提供 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置與 Meta Horizon Store 內容，並加入「passthrough」技術讓使用者在沉浸式 VR 與現實世界之間切換【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。同時，Meta 正在開發 AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）以及 2024 推出的 Orion 原型 AR 眼鏡，2025 更推出結合顯示鏡片的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，並配合可透過肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。

- **AI 整合**：Meta AI 已成為跨平台的助理，出現在各 App、AI 眼鏡與網路上，支援內容推薦、廣告工具與新產品開發，且公司持續投資於生成式 AI 與前沿 AI 模型，以提升廣告投放與使用者體驗【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。

- **資源配置**：在 2026 年，Meta 計畫將 Reality Labs 營運費用的約 70% 用於可穿戴裝置（AI 眼鏡與相關硬體），其餘 30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon 相關項目，顯示公司正把重心放在可穿戴與 AR 方向【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

- **長期願景**：Meta 把「元宇宙」描述為下一代社交技術與計算平台，認為透過 AI、可穿戴裝置與沉浸式體驗能打造「個人超智慧」的未來，並持續投入基礎設施與研發以支撐這一長期計畫【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 承認在消費硬體、VR/AR 技術上的經驗相對有限，可能面臨其他公司更有效的競爭，且元宇宙的市場接受度仍具不確定性，這些因素可能影響其產品路線與資源分配【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。

- **業務結構**：Meta 的營運分為「Family of Apps」與「Reality Labs」兩大部門，後者負責虛擬與擴增實境產品、硬體與內容，並與 Microsoft、NVIDIA 等公司合作開發相關技術【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。
